title: Autocare live corpus — source sufficiency audit
question: Is the supplied live Autocare corpus now sufficient to analyse the CURRENT curriculum end-to-end for Curriculum Assurance methodology testing?

verdict.rationale: Teaching, Block intent, Group routing, Group CEA practical assessment, Block practicals (3–4), Gateway practical+knowledge readiness, and supporting review/impact layers are now present in enough depth to shadow-review KSBs with multi-axis assurance. Remaining gaps are mostly visibility/completed-evidence/join-table items that reduce certainty for some axes but do not block controlled tranche testing. Programme-truth / trusted Golden B still requires human ratification after broader review.

Group Learning Materials; critical PPTs extracted; some legacy variants/noise remain

recommendation: Corpus is SUFFICIENT to continue controlled patterned shadow tranches. Do not continue open-ended document hunting before methodology generalisation tests. Keep residual items as visibility annotations.
